kinds.a: lorry · straight truck · chassis-cab with fitted body
kinds.d: Truck built on one chassis with its body fitted, such as a box, tipper or flatbed.
Truck made to tow a semi-trailer on a fifth-wheel coupling.
Large passenger vehicle for many seated or standing passengers; privately owned ones are mostly preserved buses or conversions such as skoolies.
Vehicle with a body made for one service, such as a fire engine, recovery truck or horsebox lorry; privately owned ones are often preserved.

notes: Restraint-only shelf. Merged k15 (Other rigid trucks), k18 (Box truck), k19 (Dump truck), k20 (Flatbed truck) into Rigid truck with types box, tipper, flatbed/dropside, chassis-cab; kept the k15 source. Kept Tractor unit (k16), Bus or coach (k13) and Special-purpose truck (k17, renamed from Special-purpose body vehicle) at kind level. Dropped all fleet/trade models as trade/institutional per the scope rule: MAN TGX, Volvo FH/FM; Irizar i6S, 12 Setra and VDL Van Hool coach models and the ComfortClass/T/TDX ranges; Rosenbauer PANTHER/RTX. Skoolies and preserved vehicles mentioned in definitions only. No brands, no new sources.
